stealth-vpn.description: De-branded full-featured VPN policy (EXCEPT OAuth2/deep-link which are excluded at source). Forbids Lantern brand identifiers only; 'lantern'/'getlantern' are case-insensitive substrings that catch all brand variants (lantern.io, lantern://, etc.) with zero generic-token false-positives. Login/payment/VPN surfaces intentionally retained. Does NOT extend the strict stealth base mode.

stealth-novpn.description: De-branded full-featured proxy (SOCKS) policy. novpn now ships the SAME real app as stealth-vpn but routes data over a local SOCKS proxy instead of a VPN tunnel, so the leak policy is identical to stealth-vpn: forbids Lantern brand identifiers + social URLs only (login/payment/servers retained). The 'no VPN tunnel' property is enforced STRUCTURALLY -- the manifest has no VpnService/BIND_VPN_SERVICE (android_manifest_filter.py) and the data path is SOCKS (radiance vpn_stealth_novpn.go) -- and verified by a manifest grep, NOT by token-scanning, because the bundled sing-box (libbox) legitimately contains TUN/tun2socks internals just like the stealth-vpn build.
